8 Help for CREATE
Usage: CREATE <filename> [-b start] [-s step] [-O] <DS definitions> <RRA definitions>

The CREATE command will create an RRD file, overwriting any existing file
unless the -O option is given or rrdcached was started with the -O option.
The start parameter needs to be in seconds since 1/1/70 (AT-style syntax is
not acceptable) and the step is in seconds (default is 300).
The DS and RRA definitions are as for the 'rrdtool create' command.

10 Help for LIST
Usage: LIST [RECURSIVE] /[<path>]

This command lists the RRD files in the storage base directory (/).
Note that this is the list of RRD files on storage as of the last update.
There may be pending updates in the queue, so a FLUSH may have to be run
beforehand.
When invoked with 'LIST RECURSIVE /<path>' it will behave similarly to
'ls -R' but limited to rrd files (listing all the rrd bases in the subtree
 of <path>, skipping empty directories).
